clues: This city in the heart of Italy stands on the Arno. That river flows past it and soon runs out to the sea.
This place sits where two kinds of weather meet. Its summers can still bring some rain, and most rain falls in the fall.
Napoleon founded a famed school here in 1810. That school was set up as a place to train top young minds.
Sea trade made this city rich in old times. That wealth paid for grand stone homes that line the banks of its river.
One tall tower here leans to one side as it stands. Folks come from all the world just to see that bent tower.
